experiences.description: As a Regional Sales Manager at Dior, I was responsible for overseeing the sales performance of multiple stores and developing and implementing regional sales strategies to achieve performance goals. By analyzing market trends and customer needs, I optimized product assortments and guided store management teams to enhance operational efficiency. Additionally, I was responsible for training and motivating the team, ensuring that the sales staff maintained a high level of professionalism and service awareness. This experience enhanced my leadership abilities and market insight, contributing to the brand's success in a competitive market

As a Store Manager at Dior, I was responsible for the overall management of store operations, including setting and achieving sales targets, team training and management, as well as maintaining customer relationships. By optimizing merchandise displays and enhancing the customer experience, I successfully improved customer satisfaction and sales performance. Additionally, I coordinated various promotional activities that effectively attracted customers and increased the store's visibility and performance. This experience significantly enhanced my leadership and business management skills
